{{Top|leg}}
'''Fest commando units''' were a smaller subdivision of the [[Fest Alliance Forces]]. Each commando unit was staffed with part-time [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], acting as lawful citizens by [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and insurgents at night. Headed by a command group of a [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]], [[Intelligence officer/Legends|intelligence officer]], and [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]], each commando unit numbered between five and twenty beings.
